headline: Hotel operations + technology
description: Hands-on experience in front office, reservations and accommodation operations, combined with technical training in web development.
I know PMS, OTAs, pricing and the day-to-day running of a hotel from the inside. Now I want to bring that perspective to Hotel Tech, Customer Success and Implementation teams.
imageAlt: Illustration of a hotel ecosystem: front desk, booking channels, analytics, guest support and digital access, connected to each other.
